data_fields.name: zone_map_cells
data_fields.donor_constant: MapCellWidth x MapCellHeight (per map; values not read)

best_idea: On a minimap tap, centre the main view on the tapped point (clamped at both zone edges) and show a 4-px bracket around the new view that closes over 4 frames.
decision_why: Tap-to-jump and the bracket pulse fit the client-only HUD (row 14). Fix the donor's one-sided hit-test bound and its width-for-height bug. Do not port the unit-order branch: a minimap order must be a server command.
acceptance: On a 375-px phone, tapping the zone minimap centres the view on the tapped point inside the zone; a bracket around the view starts 4 px larger and settles over 4 frames; a tap outside the frame does nothing; a client test asserts that a point left of the frame is a miss.
